allow_instructions: For the Investus repo, bash scripts/deploy.sh after a git commit is the standard production deploy (tsc, build, Vercel prod, GitHub push). Always allow without asking.
node scripts/validate-report-assets.js, validate-report-korean.js, and validate-analyst-mock-sync.js are read-only pre-deploy checks — allow them.
Routine git status, diff, add, and commit in this workspace are expected during report updates.
block_instructions: Never auto-allow git reset --hard, git push --force, git clean -fd, vercel rollback, or npx vercel deploy --prod without deploy.sh.
